desc: Parse H, W, and the H row strings, convert each row to an integer bitmask, and build a frequency array of size 2^W.
Define the convolution kernel g[mask] = min(popcount(mask), W - popcount(mask)).
Implement XOR convolution via Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform: transform F and G, multiply pointwise, inverse transform with scaling by 2^W, and take the minimum cost.
Validate the implementation on all three provided samples (expecting 2, 0, 13) and on edge cases (W=1, H=1, all-zero and all-one grids).
Confirm complexity is O(W*2^W) and that Python built-ins and fast list operations keep runtime within limits for W=18, H=2e5.
Write final answer to stdout in the required code-delimited format reading from stdin.
